basic_info.description: Software Engineer and AI Engineer with experience in industrial projects and process automation with AI. I worked on developing advanced solutions using C++20, Python, TypeScript, and Python-C++ integration with Pybind11, standing out for creating the Genicam-SKT library for GENICAM cameras. I have expertise in AI frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LLMs, VLMs, TensorFlow, and Docling, as well as leading automation initiatives such as PDF data extraction and NPS systems with AI. Open source contributor (Imageproc), seeking to apply technical skills in software engineering and AI challenges.

hero.subtitle: AI Automation Specialist. Full-Stack Developer with expertise in Python, Rust, C++ and computer vision. Building the future, line by line.

contact_message.paragraph: Have an interesting project or opportunity? Let's talk. I'm always open to new challenges in AI, systems and computer vision.

projects.title: Automated NPS System
projects.description: Artificial intelligence pipeline for automated analysis of customer service interactions, calculating NPS and extracting insights without manual intervention. The microservices architecture uses LangGraph for AI agent orchestration, RabbitMQ for asynchronous message processing, FastAPI for API exposure, and PostgreSQL for persistence, all containerized with Docker.

projects.title: Accounting PDF to Markdown Converter
projects.description: Batch conversion system for accounting PDF documents to structured Markdown using Vision-Language Models (VLMs). The solution uses the Docling library with VlmPipeline, processing documents in parallel via ProcessPoolExecutor with 25 workers.

projects.title: Multi-Agent Data Analysis System
projects.description: Artificial intelligence system that allows executives and analysts to perform complex queries on a PostgreSQL database using natural language. Implemented on the n8n platform with Ollama and OpenAI, it translates questions in Portuguese into optimized SQL queries.

projects.title: Blockchain Traceability Platform
projects.description: Complete architecture for traceability in the Brazilian agribusiness supply chain. Uses Hyperledger Besu, Smart Contracts, and off-chain indexing system to ensure integrity and end-to-end tracking. Aligned with DREX (Digital Real) guidelines.

projects.title: Spark Eyes System
projects.description: Automated system for weld inspection in the automotive industry, developed with C++, TensorFlow, and OpenCV. Real-time communication and monitoring modules, using the SKM-Genicam library for industrial camera control.

projects.title: SKM-Genicam Library
projects.description: Library for industrial camera control, 100% developed with smart pointers, ensuring memory safety. Solved limitations of manufacturer-provided libraries, becoming the standard in the organization.

projects.title: GitHub RAG Tool
projects.description: Tool based on RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) for AI agents capable of analyzing GitHub repositories. Uses natural language to answer questions about code, issues, and pull requests.

projects.title: Imageproc - Open Source
projects.description: Rust contributions focused on Laplacian edge detection in grayscale images. Integrated implementation with open source tools.
